source: Project specification section 4.2 / shared authorization rules; decomposed team tasks, not new requirement IDs.

useCases.title: Read own attempt
useCases.preconditions: Active account and matching active membership; real attempt snapshot; valid context.
useCases.acceptance: Read returns the exact authorized answer/version.

useCases.title: Reject direct foreign-resource access
useCases.preconditions: A second student and an existing foreign attempt, plus a missing ID.
useCases.acceptance: Foreign and missing resources have identical public status/body.

useCases.title: Apply scoped reviewer permissions
useCases.preconditions: Course membership with teacher or explicit assistant delegation.
useCases.acceptance: Review applies only to the matching course and reviewable status; another owner's draft stays private.

useCases.title: Recheck current account and membership
useCases.preconditions: Identity adapter and current membership snapshots.
useCases.acceptance: Inactive account/membership cannot read or write; changing membership affects the next write.

useCases.title: Update own draft answer
useCases.preconditions: Student owns an InProgress attempt; valid input, version and context.
useCases.acceptance: Answer changes, version increases once, and owner/course/status do not change.

useCases.title: Prevent stale or historical mutation
useCases.preconditions: Versioned attempt adapter with atomic compare-and-swap.
useCases.acceptance: A stale write conflicts without mutation; Submitted/Completed answers stay unchanged.

useCases.title: Fail closed on missing/unavailable dependency
useCases.preconditions: Explicit NotFound/Unavailable provider replies or a timeout.
useCases.acceptance: No answer or state change is exposed on failure; public foreign/missing replies remain equal.

useCases.title: Combine base authorization and context
useCases.preconditions: ACC-04 base decision and an identified/versioned context policy.
useCases.acceptance: Context can restrict but cannot grant a foreign student access.

useCases.title: Enforce server time boundaries
useCases.acceptance: Start is inclusive, end is exclusive; expired/future windows deny.

useCases.title: Reject missing or invalid policy data
useCases.preconditions: Policy snapshot with matching ID and nonempty version.
useCases.acceptance: Missing policy, wrong ID, empty version and invalid window fail closed.

useCases.title: Recheck context before the next operation
useCases.preconditions: Context reader evaluated for each request.
useCases.acceptance: A newly closed window denies the next draft write without state change.

useCases.title: Apply context to both protected actions
useCases.preconditions: ReadAttempt and UpdateDraftAnswer are explicit actions.
useCases.acceptance: Expired context denies even a draft owner; valid context cannot grant foreign writes.

useCases.title: Extend agreed contextual attributes in KT2
useCases.preconditions: Agreement on attribute providers and policy ownership/version rules.
useCases.acceptance: Define additional attributes and acceptance tests before implementing them.

tasks.title: Read own attempt and reject IDOR
tasks.prerequisites: Confirmed ACC-04 / ACC-08 assignment and specification.
tasks.acceptance: Normal owner read succeeds; changing the ID cannot reveal another student's answer.

tasks.title: Course-scoped review and current account checks
tasks.acceptance: Course/role/status rules are enforced on the server and inactive accounts are denied.

tasks.title: Versioned time-window restriction after base checks
tasks.acceptance: Base AND context is enforced; exact window boundaries and malformed/missing policies are tested.

tasks.title: Authorize and validate own draft update
tasks.acceptance: Only an active owning student can update an InProgress answer; malformed input and foreign writes do not mutate it.

tasks.title: Atomic draft version check and history protection
tasks.acceptance: Exactly one competing update succeeds; stale writes conflict; Submitted and Completed remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Normalize dependency failure without resource enumeration
tasks.acceptance: Read/write foreign and missing replies are equal when membership/context is unavailable; unavailable writer does not mutate.

tasks.title: Recheck context for reads and draft writes
tasks.acceptance: Context change is observed on the next write; neither a valid context nor reviewer role grants foreign draft write.

tasks.title: Domain model, statuses, ownership and decision matrix

tasks.title: Threat model and metadata-only change audit
tasks.acceptance: Every listed threat maps asset -> misuse -> control -> named test -> evidence; an actual update audit contains versions without answer/session data.

tasks.title: Review one ATT boundary contract with the neighboring team
tasks.acceptance: A real neighboring-team reviewer confirms the proposed snapshot/CAS/error contract; record a real review URL and version.
